title: V0 SDF-band stratification of interior error (eval-only)

fields.pressure: Cp = (p - p_inf)/q_inf recovered from the physical pred_/true_pressure (training space)
fields.velocity: U/|U_inf| (training space; includes the freestream mean); Frobenius over 3 components
fields.velocity_pert: U/|U_inf| - U_inf_dir (perturbation velocity), Frobenius over 3 components

prereg_Lref8.note: sdf from interior.point_data.sdf, unsigned distance to the full-resolution STL in the centred nondim frame (x / L_ref_meta)

nondim_unit.note: sdf from interior.point_data.sdf, unsigned distance to the full-resolution STL in the centred nondim frame (x / L_ref_meta)

gstrat_nondim_unit.note: sdf from interior.point_data.sdf, unsigned distance to the full-resolution STL in the centred nondim frame (x / L_ref_meta)

sdf_source: interior.point_data.sdf (dataset ComputeSDFFromBoundary on the full STL)

verdict.criterion: MT1-kernel far band (sdf >= 0.5 * L_ref, L_ref = 8.0, nondim frame): <= 1.0x GT survives; >= 1.5x GT closes the kernel line

notes.units: sdf and coordinates in the recipe's centred nondim frame; 1 nondim unit = global_data.L_ref = 5.0 m (all cases); preregistered L_ref = 8.0 is a constant in that frame, so far = sdf >= 4.0 nondim = 20 m physical
notes.aggregate_cross_check: the 'all' band reproduces metrics.jsonl / results/a35_v0_reduction_2026-09-05.json to 5 digits for all 8 runs
notes.mt1_far_band_pressure_is_zero_output: MT1-kernel per-case far-band pressure rel-L2 = 1.0000 +- 0.0002 for all 48 cases x 2 seeds (num2/den2 in [0.9997, 1.0002]); spot check (job 664325): |pred Cp| max 8.6e-7 in the far band. The 0.59x GT ratio is the trivial zero-predictor floor at a 0.0055-RMS Cp signal, not kernel leverage. In the 2.5 m band MT1 pressure output is non-zero (|pred Cp| up to 0.155).
notes.mt1_far_band_velocity: MT1 far-band u_x scatters 0.60-1.23 |U_inf| (band mean 0.81 vs true 1.00, run_112); RMS velocity error 0.34 |U_inf| vs GT 0.027 -> 12.6x (pooled) / 16.7x (case mean) GT.
notes.bf16_quantization: saved predictions are bf16-quantized (u steps of 1/128 near |u|=1); per-component RMS quantization error ~0.002 |U_inf|, below every band's error scale.
notes.verdict_reading: Preregistered falsifier (>= 1.5x GT in the far band on pressure and perturbation velocity) fires on velocity by an order of magnitude; the pressure <= 1.0x is a zero-output artifact. The far band as preregistered holds 0.12% of points (573 total, 4-25 per case). Under the populated 2.5 m far band MT1 is 4.49x (pressure) / 8.58x (velocity) GT. Kernel line closes on the far band.
notes.secondary_near_wall_prediction: Scoping doc 3.3 predicted MT2-interior's ratio to GT is worst near the wall (< 5 cm). Observed: near-wall is MT2's best band (SDF normals pressure 2.54x near vs 3.5-3.9x outward; velocity 2.28x vs 2.9-4.75x). The v5a3 local-detail mechanism does not describe the interior gap.
